name: The Lost Merchant
description: A merchant's cart has broken down on the road to the Forge Legion stronghold.

narrative.intro: The sound of frustrated cursing draws your attention to a merchant struggling with a broken cart wheel. Crates of supplies destined for the Forge Legion lie scattered on the dusty road. The merchant looks up with desperate hope in their eyes.

choices.text: Help repair the wheel using your strength
Offer to carry the most valuable goods yourself
Stand guard while the merchant makes repairs

A.text: Your hands find the right grip, and with a mighty heave, you reset the wheel perfectly. The merchant is astonished - this would have taken them hours! They insist you take payment from their personal stash, plus a bonus for saving their reputation with the Legion.

B.text: You shoulder the heaviest crates with ease. The merchant manages to jury-rig the wheel well enough to limp to the nearest waystation. They're grateful for your help and share their profits.

C.text: Your vigilant watch keeps bandits at bay, but the repair takes longer than expected. The merchant appreciates your protection but can only afford a modest payment after the delay costs.

lore_connection: The Forge Legion's supply routes are the lifeblood of Emberholm's industry, carrying raw materials and finished goods across the realm.
